happened.success: They asked you for more time to pay, and you agreed: a week more, no strings.
happened.partial: They asked you for more time to pay. You gave them three days more, but the debt has grown by thirty for your trouble.
happened.failure: They asked you for more time to pay. You said no, and were short with them.
happened.backfire: They asked you for more time to pay and pushed their luck. You lost patience: they have two days less.

happened.success: They asked you to go easy on them. You weighed it again and decided to be lenient.
happened.partial: They asked you to go easy on them. You will take it into account, a little.
happened.failure: They asked you to go easy on them. You did not change your mind.
happened.backfire: They asked you to go easy on them, and talked around what was reported. It has made you less inclined to be lenient.

happened.success: They asked you to trust them enough to put in a word — and you did. People will hear it.
happened.partial: They asked you to trust them. You will mention them, carefully, nothing more.
happened.failure: They asked you to trust them enough to vouch for them. You are not sure enough of them for that.
happened.backfire: They pushed too hard to be trusted. You trust them less for it, not more.
